# Villa Bond — Private Villa for Sale in Rawai, Phuket (Thailand)

> A single-storey 3-bedroom courtyard pool villa for sale in Rawai (south Phuket),
> 5 minutes from Nai Harn Beach. Sold directly by the owner. Already rented under
> professional management (turnkey rental business included).

## Property facts
- Type: Single-family villa (single storey), for sale
- Bedrooms: 3 · Bathrooms: 3
- Living area: 294.59 m² · Land plot: 405.2 m²
- Feature: private pool with stone waterfall; all bedrooms open to the pool
- Parking: covered, 2 cars · Built: 2014
- Title: Freehold, Chanote (highest form of land title in Thailand), clean, no encumbrances
- Location: Rawai, Mueang Phuket, Phuket, Thailand — ~1.6 km / 5 min to Nai Harn Beach
- Price: USD 520,000 (≈ 17,000,000 THB)
- Sold: directly by the owner, no buyer commission
- Rental: already let under management; ~8–10% net yield as a guide at
  80–90% occupancy (not a guarantee; real figures shared on request)
